ROT13 Cipher

Apply the classic ROT13 letter rotation — encoding and decoding are the same operation.

ROT13 is its own inverse — applying it twice restores the original.

📖 How to use

  1. Type or paste text.
  2. Press Convert — ROT13 encodes and decodes identically.
  3. Copy the result.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How does ROT13 work?

Each letter is shifted 13 places in the alphabet. Since 13 is half of 26, applying it twice returns the original text.

Is ROT13 secure?

ROT13 is a toy cipher for hiding spoilers and puzzle text, not real encryption.

What about numbers and symbols?

Only A–Z and a–z are rotated; numbers, punctuation and spaces are untouched.
